description: This source file provides utility functions for handling Windows error codes and HRESULTs, including message formatting, string conversion, and logging, specific to the starboard shared win32 platform.

methods.name: GetFormatHresultMessage
methods.description: Formats an HRESULT into a human-readable error message string using Windows API.

methods.name: FindHResultEnumString
methods.description: Finds the string representation of an HRESULT enum value from a predefined list.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs a Win32ErrorCode message to an output stream.

methods.name: DebugLogWinError
methods.description: Logs the last Windows error if in debug mode.

methods.name: HResultToString
methods.description: Converts an HRESULT to a descriptive string including enum name and message.
